guides.favoredWhen: Camille wins by shielding his spear with Q-start, answering stuns with R, and dueling past the first item; Pantheon wins early trades and punishes any Q2 thrown into his E.

keyTips.text: Open trades with Q, never with an auto. Your passive shield lands before his spear does, so the first damage exchange starts in your favor.
keyTips.heading: Q first

keyTips.text: Fire Q2 early when he holds E for it. He saves the shield for your true damage, so a banked proc is a blocked proc: release it before he sets.
keyTips.heading: Q2 mindgame

keyTips.text: Refuse direct trades before your first item. He wins them all, so farm with W, keep health high, and duel only after the spike lands.
keyTips.heading: Pre-item patience

tips.text: Sweep where his W landing still pays. He jumps inside your W to blunt it, so place the zone on his exit rather than his entry.
tips.heading: Inside answer

tips.text: Hold the charged Q2 as a zoning threat. He refuses it outright, so keep it glowing while he decides, and release it the moment he commits to the trade.
tips.heading: Charged zone

tips.text: Hold R for his stun and E to interrupt his engage. The pair beats every committed jump he owns, so keep both answers off cooldown when he postures.
tips.heading: Stun answer

tips.text: Ping the moment he leaves lane past level 6. His R turns other lanes while you answer with plates, so call it early and shove.
tips.heading: Roam ping

tips.text: Take past the first item the duels you refused early. The lane flips at the spike, so punish the windows his spent cooldowns leave.
tips.heading: Item turn

tips.text: Wait out empowered E instead of feeding it Q2. Its duration eats the proc outright, so hold the kick until the shield drops.
tips.heading: Shield wait

sources.author: procatking
sources.rankClaim: Emerald (badge, no title claim) · Pantheon main

guides.favoredWhen: Camille wins by refusing shroud fights, banking a health lead with wall-angle trades, and committing only after her E2 and R2 are spent.

keyTips.text: Open every exchange with poke near walls after her Q is spent, and refuse to chase into shroud. Long shroud fights are where she wins; short wall trades are where you do.
keyTips.heading: Trading rule

keyTips.text: Bank a health lead before committing. Chunk her with shielded shorts first, and take the all-in only while you are up on health.
keyTips.heading: Health-lead rule

keyTips.text: Hold Hookshot and Hextech Ultimatum for spent mobility. She dodges your E with her own E and holds E2 and R2 for your R landing, so engage only after those answers are gone.
keyTips.heading: Answer discipline

tips.text: Levels 1 to 3, poke when she steps for farm and trade behind your passive shield, but never chase extended E lines. Her Q downtime is the window; her up-Q near a wall is her turn, not yours.
tips.heading: Levels 1–3

tips.text: Time engages for right after her Q. She fights in Q, passive auto, Q bursts, so stepping in on her spent Q leaves her without the pattern while your shield and second Q are ready.
tips.heading: Q timing

tips.text: Keep fights near walls for Hookshot angles. She wants open ground where your E finds nothing, so pull skirmishes toward terrain and punish her drift into the open.
tips.heading: Positioning

tips.text: Zone her approach with the outer ring of your W. She refuses to stand in it, which funnels her Q, passive, Q pattern into the line your E is already holding.
tips.heading: Wave and zone

tips.text: Commit the ultimatum only from a health lead with her E2 and R2 tracked as spent. She has no answer left at that point, and the Grasp plus cookies scaling she relies on never arrives.
tips.heading: Closing rule

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: Camille wins by varying Hookshot timing to bait Riposte and trading only behind her shield; Fiora wins any fight where she parries the engage.

keyTips.text: Vary Hookshot timing every trade to bait her Riposte. A predictable E gets parried and stunned, which ends the fight before your second Q lands.
keyTips.heading: Hookshot timing

keyTips.text: Trade only with your passive shield up and deny her free vitals. Shieldless autos into her let her proc and kite for nothing.
keyTips.heading: Shield rule

keyTips.text: Never ult into a held Riposte on a gank. She saves W for your R landing, so commit the ultimatum only after her parry is gone.
keyTips.heading: Ult discipline

tips.text: Fight near walls for Hookshot angles and keep her in the open off them. Her game is open-ground vitals, so pull every skirmish toward terrain she cannot ignore.
tips.heading: Terrain rule

tips.text: Sweep at max range where she must Q or eat the outer hit. If she burns Q to exit, her disengage is gone and your E window opens.
tips.heading: Sweep setup

tips.text: Hold your second Q until her kite options are spent. She walks away with vital and ult move speed after Q1, so proc Q2 only once she has committed position.
tips.heading: Q2 patience

tips.text: Bait mid-lane Hookshots without committing, then re-engage. She answers the first E with positioning, so the second cast after her cooldowns is the real engage.
tips.heading: E baiting

tips.text: Commit from a health lead with her Flash and Riposte tracked as spent. Her wall-bait setup needs both, and without them she cannot punish your engage.
tips.heading: Closing rule

tips.text: Split away from her rather than dueling even. She controls the 1v1 once Riposte timing settles, so carry fights with roams and picks instead.
tips.heading: Macro answer

sources.author: TTVJustSad42
sources.rankClaim: Challenger EUNE / Grandmaster EUW (self-claim, no badge) · Fiora main

guides.favoredWhen: Camille wins by fighting only spent-Q windows with Q-start pressure and answering Q3 with R; Aatrox wins if he spaces Q zones, holds E for her commits, and denies early autos with his passive.

keyTips.text: Start Q and fight the level-1 brush. The first levels are your strongest, so bank the lead before his range and sustain matter.
keyTips.heading: Level-1 brush

keyTips.text: Start every trade after he spends Q. Cancel autos to bait the cast when he aims at your last-hits, then go while the cooldowns are dark.
keyTips.heading: Q clock

keyTips.text: Threaten with a held R to starve his rotation. He withholds Q3 while your ultimate is up, so the menace of the dodge punishes the forced cast that follows.
keyTips.heading: Held R

tips.text: Never trade autos into his ready passive. Space the Q zone and wait the proc out instead of donating health for stacks you cannot win.
tips.heading: Passive respect

tips.text: Take the opening trade when he spends E early. Without the dash his Q sequence cannot track you, so punish the wasted mobility at once.
tips.heading: E opening

tips.text: Chip with shorts past level 6 and hold R to dodge one Q in the all-in. The dodge turns his committed rotation into your kill window.
tips.heading: Post-6 chip

tips.text: E out the instant his W pull catches you. Staying gifts him the chain his Q3 ends, so exit first and re-engage on your terms.
tips.heading: W exit

tips.text: Never Hookshot onto a spot where his Q sweet spot waits. Pick landings outside his drawn zones, since a predicted entry is a free knock-up for him.
tips.heading: Landing rule

tips.text: Spend E as an exit, not an entry, in the deciding fights. He watches your Hookshot to time Q3, so keep it holstered until you need the escape.
tips.heading: E discipline
